beats.say: Angel Reese just became the third player with 30 points and 15 rebounds in a WNBA finals game.
The Guardian says her double double helped the Atlanta Dream beat the Golden State Valkyries 79-65.
The victory on Monday night marks the first finals win in the franchise's history.
It evens the best of seven series at one game apiece.
Rhyne Howard also set a WNBA finals record during the game by recording six steals.
Reese finished with 30 points and 16 rebounds to secure the historic result.
Can the Dream win their first WNBA championship?
